title: SpaceX launches new V3 Starlink satellites but suffers another booster failure
summary: SpaceX successfully deployed V3 Starlink satellites during its second Starship test flight, but encountered another booster engine reignition issue. The incident underscores ongoing challenges with booster reusability as the company works toward fully operational Starship missions.
content: The company ticked off a few more boxes on the second Starship V3 flight, but appears to have had another issue relighting the booster's rocket engines.

zh.title: SpaceX推出新的V3 Starlink卫星,但又遭遇助推器故障
zh.summary: SpaceX在第二次Starship测试飞行中成功部署了V3 Starlink卫星,但遇到了另一个助推器发动机重新点火问题。这一事件突显了该公司在实现完全可操作的Starship任务过程中,助推器可重用性面临的持续挑战。

title: Wildfire forces evacuation of NASA's Deep Space Network complex in Spain
summary: A wildfire forced evacuation of NASA's Deep Space Network facility in Spain, raising concerns about potential damage to critical space communications infrastructure. The facility plays a crucial role in NASA's deep space missions and communication with distant spacecraft.
content: "Any potential damage will be assessed when it is safe to do so."

title: After backlash, Meta pauses plan to ‘rate limit’ its smart glasses
summary: Meta has paused plans to charge $20 monthly for Conversation Focus, an accessibility feature in its smart glasses that runs locally without cloud infrastructure, following public backlash. However, the company remains committed to introducing subscription-based premium features in the future.
content:
Remember when Meta was planning to charge a $20 monthly subscription fee for the smart glasses feature that lets people hear each other more clearly - even though that feature runs locally on your glasses and doesn't require the cloud? Meta has paused those plans, spokesperson Tyler Yee confirms to The Verge.
The company is not giving up on the idea of a subscription fee for certain features - that's still moving forward. Yee confirms that "some premium features will be subscription-based over time."
But Conversation Focus, the accessibility feature, "will remain available for free through our Early Access Program for early testers while w …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: Meta在遭到反对后暂停智能眼镜"限流"计划

title: Prentis, new AI lab co-founded by Reid Hoffman, Mark Pincus in talks to raise $100M
summary: Prentis, a new AI lab founded by Reid Hoffman and Mark Pincus, is seeking to raise $100 million and betting that AI-driven automation of routine computer tasks will become the dominant use case. The venture reflects growing belief that task automation may soon surpass software development as AI's primary business impact.
content: The neolab is betting that automating routine computer tasks will soon outpace coding as AI's biggest use case.

zh.title: 由Reid Hoffman和Mark Pincus联合创办的新AI实验室Prentis寻求融资1亿美元
zh.summary: 由Reid Hoffman和Mark Pincus创办的新AI实验室Prentis正在寻求融资1亿美元，并押注AI驱动的日常计算机任务自动化将成为主导用例。这项计划反映了越来越多人相信任务自动化可能很快会超越软件开发，成为AI的主要商业影响。

title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026’s new Smart Money Stage explores fintech, payments, AI, and everything between
summary: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 is launching a dedicated Smart Money Stage to explore the evolving landscape of fintech, payments, and AI-driven financial innovation. The new stage reflects how money and financial services have fundamentally transformed beyond traditional banking.
content: Money has evolved into far more than the cash in your wallet or your bank account. And at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026, we’re devoting an entire stage to that progression.

zh.title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026推出新的"Smart Money"舞台，探索金融科技、支付和AI
zh.summary: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026正在推出一个专门的"Smart Money"舞台，探讨金融科技、支付和AI驱动的金融创新的不断演变。这个新舞台反映了金钱和金融服务已经超越传统银行业而发生了根本性转变。

title: Paramount/WBD merger delayed for months as states' lawsuit moves toward trial
summary: The proposed Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery merger faces a multi-month delay as a state lawsuit progresses toward trial, according to New York's Attorney General. The legal challenge aims to prevent what critics view as a problematic consolidation in the media and entertainment industry.
content: “Halting this merger while our case proceeds is a critical victory," NY AG said.

The incident highlights ongoing tensions around AI integration in official government communications.

title: Vietnam is looking to restrict social media for kids; here are the growing number of other countries doing the same
summary: Vietnam is considering restrictions on social media access for children, joining a growing global trend that began with Australia's ban in late 2025. These efforts aim to protect young users from cyberbullying, addiction, and predatory behavior.
content: Australia was the first country to issue a ban in late 2025, aiming to reduce the pressures and risks that young users may face on social media, including cyberbullying, social media addiction, and exposure to predators.

zh.title: 越南寻求限制儿童社交媒体；越来越多的国家也在采取相同措施

title: Anthropic's Opus 5 is about token efficiency, not a capability leap
summary: Anthropic's Opus 5 prioritizes token efficiency and cost reduction over dramatic capability improvements, reflecting market trends toward more economical AI models. The focus underscores that cheaper alternatives often provide sufficient performance for many use cases.

Qualcomm sent a letter to customers on Friday warning of plans to increase its prices by "a percentage in the double digits," Bloomberg reports. The price hikes will go into effect starting with products shipped after September 1st. 
Qualcomm claims it has "exhausted its ability to absorb higher costs from suppliers," as ongoing component shortages continue to drive up prices. The company also said it attempted to source components from alternate suppliers prior to announcing the price hikes.

Midjourney, which has gone from generating AI cat images to full-body ultrasound scans, is getting into a new field: astrology. The AI startup announced on Thursday that it has acquired the personalized astrology app Co-Star, as reported earlier by Bloomberg.
Co-Star is a free app that offers daily horoscopes and allows you to check your compatibility with friends. As noted on the app's FAQ page, it combines human insight, data from NASA, and AI to deliver personalized advice for users each day. The terms of Midjourney's deal, which reportedly closed in spring, haven't been disclosed.
Midjourney founder David Holz says Co-Star founder Banu …

title: DJI camera clone company Xtra is halting and refunding all preorders

The Xtra Muse 2 Pro. | Image; Xtra

title: Nothing confirms layoffs, but calls market exit rumors ‘fake news’
summary: Phone maker Nothing confirmed it is laying off staff and reorganizing but denies reports of market exits, characterizing those claims as "fake news." The company says it's consolidating into regional hubs and launching an "AI-native" business unit amid rising component costs.

In response to a report that Nothing is planning to "exit 12 markets as global shipments decline," Nothing cofounder Akis Evangelidis said the company is "reorganizing" and laying off some of its staff, but that "the reported numbers are way overblown." Evangelidis disputed a claim about underwhelming sales for Nothing's Phone 4B, saying it "sold 29,537 units on Day 1 only, breaking records in its price segment."
He also said Nothing isn't shutting down in any markets, and is instead "consolidating" its operations into regional hubs as well as introducing an "AI-native" business unit.

title: Why Cognition bought Poke: AI personality is becoming a competitive advantage
summary: AI coding startup Cognition acquired conversational assistant Poke in a low nine-figure deal to integrate Poke's user-friendly interaction style into its Devin coding agent. The acquisition reflects industry consensus that AI interaction design is as strategically important as underlying model capabilities.
content: AI coding startup Cognition has acquired Poke, the AI assistant you text like a friend, in a deal valuing the startup in the low nine figures. The acquisition brings Poke’s conversational style and interaction model to Cognition’s coding agent Devin, reflecting a growing belief that how AI assistants interact with users is as important as the models powering them.

summary: A federal judge rejected the Trump administration's demand for phone records from New York Times reporters, offering the government the option to withdraw the subpoenas instead. The ruling protects press freedom amid heightened tensions with media outlets.

The case highlights tension between national security interests and individual privacy protections.

content: New delay on Copernicus satellite pics comes as US ramps up war with Iran again.

title: You can’t ignore Google Zero anymore
summary: Google's declining referral traffic to websites is dismantling the decades-long exchange where Google indexed content in return for directing user traffic to publishers. Major publishers are now considering blocking Google from crawling their sites entirely, marking a fundamental shift in web economics.
content:
The web and Google once had a deal: Google collects data and indexes webpages and in exchange sends oceans of traffic to websites. The deal wasn't perfect and certainly made Google more money than it made the websites, but it worked for a long time. Now, however, the deal seems to be dead. And the web is being forced to reckon with what happens when the Google traffic dries up.

Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: 你再也不能忽视Google Zero了
zh.summary: 谷歌对网站的推荐流量下降正在瓦解数十年来的交换模式，即谷歌为了向发布者引导用户流量而索引内容。主要发布者现在正在考虑完全阻止谷歌爬取他们的网站，标志着网络经济的根本转变。

title: Build in public, fail in public: what it’s like to be a founder under 20 right now
summary: Young entrepreneurs under 20 are leveraging AI tools to launch companies faster than ever before, bypassing traditional paths through established tech firms. This democratization of development is reshaping startup culture and founder demographics.
content: AI tools have democratized the opportunity to build, shortening the timelines of success and enabling more young people to start successful companies without stepping foot inside a Big Tech company.

zh.title: 在公众面前构建，在公众面前失败：20 岁以下创始人的现状
zh.summary: 20 岁以下的年轻企业家正在利用人工智能工具以前所未有的速度创办公司，绕过了通过成熟科技公司的传统路径。这种开发的民主化正在重塑初创企业文化和创始人的人口特征。

title: Anthropic launches Opus 5
summary: Anthropic has released Opus 5, a new AI model positioned as both more affordable and less restrictive than its Fable predecessor. The launch suggests improved value proposition and expanded use cases for developers and enterprises.
content: Opus 5 will be both cheaper and less restrictive than Fable, likely making it preferable in most use cases.

zh.title: Anthropic 推出 Opus 5
zh.summary: Anthropic 推出了 Opus 5，一个新的人工智能模型，定位为比其 Fable 前身更便宜且限制更少。这次发布表明了对开发者和企业的更好价值主张和扩大的用例。

title: OpenAI’s new voice mode makes it to the ChatGPT desktop app
summary: OpenAI has rolled out voice functionality to ChatGPT's desktop application, enabling it to work with ChatGPT Work and Codex features to complete tasks and control agents. This expansion brings conversational AI capabilities to desktop workflows, making voice interactions more accessible for task automation.
content: ChatGPT Voice on desktop can work with both ChatGPT Work and Codex to complete tasks and control agents.

zh.title: OpenAI的新语音模式已在ChatGPT桌面应用上推出
zh.summary: OpenAI已在ChatGPT桌面应用上推出语音功能，使其能够与ChatGPT Work和Codex功能协作完成任务和控制代理。这一扩展将对话AI功能引入桌面工作流程，使语音交互在任务自动化中更加便捷。

title: Facebook launches a dedicated Marketplace app for sellers, adds a free verification system
summary: Facebook has launched Seller, a dedicated mobile app designed for frequent marketplace sellers to manage listings and sales. The new app aims to streamline the selling experience for power users who regularly use Facebook's marketplace platform.
content: Seller is a dedicated Marketplace app for people who list and sell items frequently.

zh.title: Facebook为卖家推出专属Marketplace应用，并新增免费验证系统
zh.summary: Facebook推出了Seller应用，这是一款为经常在市场平台上销售的卖家设计的专属移动应用，用于管理商品列表和销售。该应用旨在为定期使用Facebook市场平台的主要用户简化销售体验。

title: Whack-a-drone
summary: An investigation into Odyssey Robot, a US drone startup, reveals minimal operational signs at its claimed Pasadena headquarters within a shared coworking space. The discovery raises questions about the company's legitimacy and whether it has sufficient resources to deliver on its drone technology promises.
content:
In Pasadena, California, there's a cute red brick courtyard where one storefront isn't like the rest. The glass doors open onto a sparse industrial hallway, which leads to a sunlit foyer with a large spiral staircase. Go up, and you'll see a typical coworking space: open tables, healthy snacks, a collection of meeting rooms with glass walls. Follow one hallway most of the way back, and you'll find Office 18.
There are no signs of life in this tiny private office that's supposed to be the headquarters of Odyssey Robot, an upstart US drone company. We saw three small desks and chairs, but no power strips, no monitors, no keyboards or chargers …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: 无人机初创公司调查曝光
zh.summary: 对美国无人机初创公司Odyssey Robot的调查显示，在其声称位于帕萨迪纳的共享办公空间总部中，几乎没有运营迹象。这一发现引发了人们对该公司合法性以及其是否具有足够资源来兑现其无人机技术承诺的质疑。

title: TikTok’s protection of minors should not be opt-in, warns EU
summary: The European Commission has issued preliminary findings under the Digital Services Act requiring TikTok to make child protection measures mandatory rather than optional. The EU demands that minors' accounts default to private visibility and that their content not be algorithmically recommended to other users.
content:
TikTok has attracted the ire of the European Union over its protection of children who use the video sharing platform. The European Commission announced preliminary findings today under the Digital Services Act (DSA) that offer specific issues to address.
The Commission suggests that TikTok should adjust the default settings of minors' "public" accounts so the content they post is only visible to TikTok users the teen has chosen to share it with, and that such content shouldn't be recommended to other users in the For You feed. Even accounts set to private can be easily discovered through the "following" lists of other users, and their prof …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: TikTok的未成年人保护措施不应是可选的，欧盟警告
zh.summary: 欧盟委员会根据《数字服务法》发布初步调查结果，要求TikTok将儿童保护措施从可选改为强制性。欧盟要求未成年人账户默认为私密可见，其内容不应被算法推荐给其他用户。

title: Robot snakes searched for Venezuela earthquake survivors in collapsed buildings
summary: US robotics researchers deployed snake-shaped robots to Venezuela following an earthquake to search collapsed buildings for survivors. The specialized snakebots represent an innovative approach to disaster response and rescue operations in challenging environments.
content: US robotics researchers flew to Venezuela with snakebots after getting a call.

zh.title: 机器蛇在委内瑞拉地震后在倒塌建筑中搜救幸存者
zh.summary: 美国机器人研究人员在委内瑞拉地震后部署了蛇形机器人，在倒塌建筑中搜救幸存者。这些专门设计的蛇形机器人代表了在恶劣环境中进行灾难响应和救援行动的创新方法。

title: Facebook considers giving up and becoming TikTok
summary: Meta is testing a full-screen video experience on Facebook to compete with TikTok and prevent user migration to rival platforms. The experimental interface, launching first in video-focused markets, signals Meta's strategic pivot toward short-form video to retain users.
content:
Facebook is planning some big changes to try and keep its users from jumping to rival social platforms like TikTok - changes that sound dubiously similar to becoming a TikTok clone. Facebook head Tom Alison announced today that the platform will begin testing a "reimagined experience" later this year that will put a subset of users into a "full-screen video the moment they open the app."
Meta didn't share examples of what its experimental new interface will look like, only that it will initially roll out to countries with a noted preference for video content, with a potential expansion planned for the US next year. These tests are driven by …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: Facebook考虑放弃并转变为TikTok
zh.summary: Meta正在Facebook上测试全屏视频体验，以与TikTok竞争并防止用户流向竞争对手平台。该实验性界面首先在以视频为中心的市场推出，标志着Meta战略性地转向短视频以留住用户。

title: Microsoft pressures LG into killing unwanted McAfee ads
summary: Microsoft has successfully pressured LG to disable McAfee antivirus trial pop-ups that were appearing on Windows 11 PCs connected to LG monitors. The intervention addresses widespread user frustration over bloatware ads that appeared after LG driver installations.
content:
Microsoft has intervened to stop Windows 11 users with LG monitors from being bombarded with annoying McAfee trial pop-ups. In response to complaints about the LG bloatware, Microsoft's Windows chief, Pavan Davuluri, said that LG has agreed to immediately disable the McAfee pop-up from its LG Monitor App Installer, and pledged that Microsoft will "keep improving here with our ecosystem partners."
This crackdown follows backlash about large pop-up ads for McAfee antivirus and LG's own apps appearing on Windows 11 PCs after being connected to LG monitors. Upon connection, a Windows driver update was silently installing LG driver updates and t …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: 微软向LG施压，禁用McAfee不需要的广告弹出
zh.summary: 微软成功地向LG施压，要求禁用在连接到LG显示器的Windows 11电脑上出现的McAfee防病毒试用版弹出式广告。此举解决了用户对LG驱动程序安装后出现的捆绑软件广告的广泛不满。

title: How AI guardrails are impeding the work of offensive cybersecurity researchers
summary: AI safety guardrails from OpenAI and Anthropic are restricting cybersecurity researchers' ability to develop and test security tools for finding vulnerabilities. While these safeguards aim to prevent misuse, they inadvertently limit legitimate defensive security research needed to identify and fix exploitable weaknesses.
content: We spoke with several cybersecurity researchers, who look for unknown vulnerabilities and develop tools to exploit them, about how OpenAI’s and Anthropic’s guardrails affect their work.

zh.title: AI 安全防护措施如何阻碍了攻防安全研究人员的工作
zh.summary: 来自 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的 AI 安全防护措施限制了网络安全研究人员开发和测试安全工具来发现漏洞的能力。虽然这些安全措施旨在防止滥用，但它们无意中限制了识别和修复可利用漏洞所需的合法防御性安全研究。

title: Meet the judges who will crown Australia’s next breakout startup
summary: TechCrunch is launching its Startup Battlefield competition in Australia in partnership with Stripe to identify and celebrate promising early-stage startups. The program will feature industry judges evaluating emerging companies across the Australian startup ecosystem.
content: TechCrunch Startup Battlefield is coming to Australia — and we're partnering with Stripe to find the country's most exciting early-stage startups.

zh.title: 认识将决出澳大利亚下一个爆红初创公司的评委
zh.summary: TechCrunch 与 Stripe 合作在澳大利亚推出其初创公司竞技场竞赛，以发现和表彰有前景的早期创业公司。该计划将汇集行业评委，评估澳大利亚初创生态系统中的新兴公司。
